title: dactylorhiza cordigera subsp. graeca
intro: Dactylorhiza cordigera subsp. graeca, commonly known as the Greek marsh orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the genus Dactylorhiza. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include its potential to improve cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza cordigera subsp. graeca include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
